items.title: competence_floor R4 819a: reconcile worst-seed non-vacuity gate with strict-majority router + recalibrate 1.0 floor/margin (MECH-457/INV-088 z_world instrument-validity)
items.note: SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-819. TEST-DESIGN FIX (measurement_test_design_defect adjudicated in failure_autopsy_batch-793a-817-819_2026-07-26.md target 3, user-confirmed 2026-07-26). The 819 run's non-vacuity GATE and routing PREDICATE disagreed on the same data: post_bc_install_took scored install on the WORST seed (trained 0.9 vs 1.0 on seed 43, a 0.1 near-miss; random 0.4) so BOTH arms went red and the run was vacated zworld_advantage_grid_nondiscriminative, while the router's strict-majority install_took (trained 2/3, random 0/3) read an asymmetric-install advantage (headline.advantage_confirmed=true). The z_world encoder DID train (819 world_encoder_max_abs_delta 0.277-0.333, 3/3 seeds; V3-EXQ-780 frozen-random-projection fault stays fixed). THREE FIXES, all measurement (substrate + science unchanged): (1) post_bc_install_took now scored on the STRICT-MAJORITY install FRACTION (>0.5), the IDENTICAL predicate the router uses, so gate==router by construction and a non-installing control (0.0) never vacates the trained arm (0.667 green) -- realising the precondition's own 'NON-vacating per-arm' docstring; per-seed install stays at the 1.0 substrate floor (the defect was worst-seed aggregation, not the floor value). (2) ADVANTAGE_ABS_FLOOR 1.0->0.3, rescaled to the 0.35-2.4 res/ep near-floor band (~2% of the 48.05 local_view / 57.2 oracle ceiling; 819's 1.0 margin demanded a near-doubling and dominated the 0.15 relative bar). (3) seeds 3->6 (42..47), matching the 793a repower, for a firmer 4/6 strict-majority (with fix 1 a single seed no longer vacates under any rule). RE-DERIVE BRAKE DOES NOT FIRE: under R3 only genuine substrate_ceiling autopsies count and MECH-457/INV-088 have ZERO (whole campaign is competence_implementation_gap/measurement_test_design_defect); a test-design fix of an already-run leg is not a same-question ceiling re-pose. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = reconciled trained-vs-random z_world competence at strict-majority over 6 seeds; 819 vacated the run and recorded no such scored readout -> must run. DIAGNOSTIC (claim_ids MECH-457+INV-088 excluded from scoring; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy). Resolves the pre-registered competence_floor R4 frozen-ledger leg H-zworld-trained-instrument (alive, awaiting a scored run). Reference build 128/3x/detached (NOT 769-falsified 256/5x). CONTROL arm (zworld_random_proj) mints reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False, shared lineage slice). Smoke PASS (dry-run full pipeline: encoder trains on trained arm, guard fires non-gating on control, eff_margin=0.3 live); validate_experiments/validate_recording --strict OK.

items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier, phase-sync redesign of the lockstep arm (supersedes V3-EXQ-827)
items.note: REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-827 (SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-827; failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26.md section 4, user-confirmed 2026-07-26). 827 measured decouple=0.2262 < intact=0.2715, but the second pre-registered inequality REVERSED: lockstep=0.1679 was the LOWEST-similarity arm, not the highest, so C1 (non-degeneracy) failed and self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue. Traced to `_force_lockstep()` collapsing e1/e2/e3 steps_per_tick to 1 (the fastest native rate), which conflates the intended manipulation (phase synchrony) with an unintended tick-density change: E3's own deliberation/commit machinery, whose native cadence is 1 tick per 10 env-steps, was forced to run 10x more often than by design. `q081_surrogate.cross_stream_xcorr`'s lag sweep is expressed in ticks of each pair's own coarser stream, so `max_lag_ticks=8` spans ~80 real env-steps for an E1-vs-E3 pair under intact (coarse period ~10) but only ~8 real env-steps under the old lockstep (coarse period collapsed to 1) -- a scale mismatch that could pull the max-|correlation| statistic in either direction. TWO FIXES, both scoped to the lockstep arm's construction/readout ONLY (decouple and intact are byte-identical in mechanism to V3-EXQ-827 -- same clock rates, same scrambler, same fixed max_lag_ticks=8 call): (1) `_force_lockstep()` now collapses e1/e2/e3 to E3's OWN native base rate (`agent.clock._e3_base_steps`, read dynamically, never hardcoded) instead of to 1 -- still literal tick-time coincidence across all three streams (genuine lockstep), but GUARANTEES no stream is EVER sampled more densely than under intact; E3's own cadence and computation are completely unchanged, only E1/E2 slow down to meet it. (2) For lockstep ONLY, a post-hoc recomputation over the already-recorded trace picks per-pair max_lag_ticks so the real-step span probed matches what intact used for that SAME pair (periods measured from data via q081_surrogate.estimate_tick_period, never assumed from config, per that module's own MECH-091/MECH-093-robustness rule) -- closing the residual scale mismatch on the two pairs (z_world-z_self, z_world-z_goal) whose coarse period changes under fix (1) but was previously left at the old confounded reading in V3-EXQ-827 for ALL four pairs. The raw ticks=8 lockstep reading is retained as a manifest diagnostic (`cross_stream_similarity_raw_ticks8`); the matched reading is primary. Neither the shared library `experiments/_lib/q081_surrogate.py` nor any other consumer (V3-EXQ-824, tests/contracts/test_q081_surrogate_null.py) is touched -- the matching is computed locally in this script and applied only to lockstep's own readout. THRESHOLDS UNCHANGED (SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR=0.02, COMPOSITE_MARGIN=0.15, identical to 827): the redesign targets the validity/direction of the lockstep reading, not the predicted effect size, so recalibrating the floor would be tuning to the answer rather than to the design change; if C1 still fails under the corrected design that is itself the informative reading. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: INV-091 has exactly 1 prior autopsy (the one above) -- below the >=2 threshold, brake does not fire; this IS the routed redesign. GOV-REUSE-1: reanalysis_query.py --claim INV-091 re-checked 2026-07-26 after V3-EXQ-827 landed -- its own manifest is the only hit and its lockstep arm is exactly the confounded reading this redesign replaces; not recoverable, first run under the corrected design. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 eps/2 eval eps/20 steps): runs end-to-end, self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale (expected, matches 827's own dry-run precedent), and the matched-lag-ticks logic visibly engages (one pair computed max_lag_ticks=1 instead of the default 8 at toy-scale measured periods, confirming the real-time-matching branch is live, not a no-op). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings. validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest: OK, always-core complete.
